description: Scroll the page or a scrollable container (by ref or selector). Essential for infinite-scroll feeds — but for harvesting feed data, prefer the browser_extract_* tools with their scrolls param, which scroll+extract+dedupe in one call.

ref.description: Scroll within the container with this ref from browser_snapshot.

returnSnapshot.description: Legacy inline snapshot (tree modes). Prefer the "snapshot" param, which returns ref-based AI snapshots.

selector.description: Scroll within a specific scrollable element instead of the window.

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

snapshot.description: Optionally include an AI snapshot after scrolling ("diff" = only what changed).

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session. Auto-resolved from environment if omitted.

name: browser_scroll
